senses.gloss: शृङ्ग- + उच्छ्राय शृङ्ग- + उच्छ्राय, m. a lofty top, Megh. 59.
शृङ्गार-एक- + रस शृङ्गार-एक- + रस, adj. only pleased with love, Vikr. d. 9.
शृङ्गार- + विधि शृङ्गार- + विधि, m. dress fit for amorous interviews, Pañc. 35, 15.
शृङ्गार- + वेश शृङ्गार- + वेश, adj. dressed suitably for amorous enterprises, MBh. 5, 237.

शृङ्खल शृङ्खल, m., f. ला, and n.
 1. A chain, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 12 (ला).
 2. A belt worn round a man's body.
 --Comp.

शृङ्ग शृङ्ग, probably शर + म्-ग (cf. शॄ),
 I. n.
 1. A horn, Pañc. 9, 7; a horn-like vessel, Ragh. 16, 70.
 2. The top of a mountain, Bhartṛ. 2, 77; Daśak. in Chr. 188, 21 (उदय-अचल-इन्द्र-पद्मराग-शृङ्ग-कल्पा, As if it [viz. the sun] was the ruby top of the mountain उदय); summit of a building, Pañc. 10, 8.
 3. Height, dignity.
 4. Sovereignty.
 5. A mark.
 6. A lotus.
 7. An artificial fountain.
 II. f. गी.
 1. A fish, a sort of silurus.
 2. A sort of drug.
 3. A sort of gold used for making trinkets.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. as akin, κέρας; Lat. cornu; Goth. haurn; A.S. horn.

शृङ्गवेर शृङ्गवेर,
 I. n. Ginger.
 II. Name of a town, Utt. Rāmac. 14, 10.
शृङ्गाट शृङ्गाट, and शृङ्गाटक शृङ्गाट + क, n. A place where four roads meet.

शृङ्गार शृङ्गार (from शृङ्ग, cf. the next),
 I. m.
 1. Copulation, coition, Pañc. i. d. 191.
 2. Love, Vikr. d. 9; as an object of poetical description.
 3. (m. or n.?), Elegant dress (properly, a dress for amorous purposes), Pañc. 36, 18 (cf. my transl. n. 173).
 4. Marks made with red lead on an elephant's head and trunk.
 5. Mark in general, Lass. 69, 5 (at the end of a comp. adj.).
 II. n.
 1. Red lead.
 2. Cloves.
 3. Fragrant powder for the dress or person.
शृङ्गिण शृङ्गिण, i. e. शृङ्गिन् + अ, m. A ram.

शृङ्गिन् शृङ्गिन्, i. e. शृङ्ग + इन्,
 I. adj., f. इणी.
 1. Horned, Hit. i. d. 18, M.M.
 2. Crested, peaked.
 II. m.
 1. A mountain.
 2. A tree.
 3. An elephant.
 III. f. इणी, A cow.
 --Comp.
